comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: It was 500m on its debut in ticket, 1b the very next day, and 1.5-2b day after that. Prices always vary to say the least, so don't be afraid to haggle or be patient, and remember that the UWO DB no longer seems to tolerate WTS/WTB comments nowadays. Price checks seem okay though. Got mine for 1b, for whatever it's worth... Cheers.
